title: The Werewolfs Of Millercraft
description: An minigame inspired by Among Us, in Werewolf style!
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d68becab5231859435f53ae6c451045a111a09c_0.webp)

**Experience a world, like never before. No one is safe, you're constantly being haunted.** 


The Werewolves Of Millecraft has been inspired by the popular game _**The Werewolves of Millers Hollow**_

The goal of the game is to find the '**_Werewolf_**' (Imposter). Players get after each night 5 minutes of talking time before they need to vote for who they think the Werewolf is.



This plugin offers the following commands:

/join - **Join the game, if it hasn't started yet.**

/start - **Start the game.**

/vote - **Gives the voting menu (only works when vote time)**

/resetgame - **[OP] Resets the game, usefull for when something goes wrong.**

/wwsettings - **[OP] Shows the settings menu.**

/setrole [USERNAME] [ROLE] - **[OP] Changes the role of the user in the next match.**





This mod has the following roles:

Wolf - **Kill other participants and don't get voted out!**

Thanner - **If you get voted out, you win!**

Seer - **In the first night, the seer is able to see someones role.**

Thief - **In the second night, the thief is able to steal someones role. The target will become a villager.**

Mayor - **The mayor has the ability to have his vote count twice.**


More soon!



This project is a fan project from the game _**The Werewolves of Millers Hollow**_. We're not assiciated in any way.
